description: Verify that the receiver TCP checks the checksum and does NOT acknowledge in case of an error (RFC 1122 §4.2.2.7 p86)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion of CHECKSUM_01: a corrupted-checksum segment must be silently dropped — no ACK, no other response.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with deliberately wrong checksum.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT emit an ACK for the bad-checksum data.

[Pass condition]
No DUT ACK to corrupt-checksum data.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_unexpected_ack — DUT acked corrupt-checksum data (checksum verification disabled)

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently dropped bad-checksum data — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK within listen window
